newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down marginally after London rise.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down marginally after London rise.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price dipped a cent to 14.20 ringgit ($5.67) a kg after players tried to cash in on the market's recent strength, traders said.
The London Metal Exchange (LME) closed $25 higher overnight and prompted active selling, although some good buying emerged later, the traders said.
"The market has been a bit firm lately and that's why players cashed in on the LME's rise," said a trader.
Offers totalled 135 tonnes against bids of 61. Turnover was 125 tonnes from 104 previously. The premium against the LME fell to $65 from $90. -- K. Baranee (603-2307509) ($1=2.5060)
